scope.summary: Implement garment fix dials per Section 13.24 (REQ-027, Fit Control made native): auto-generated per-region ease/expand adjustment channels on every fitted garment so operators and models can fix poke-through or tightness on extreme bodies with a dial instead of re-authoring the garment.
acceptance_criteria: Fitting a garment auto-generates a fix-dial set for each body region mask the garment overlaps (ease/expand/loosen per region, e.g. chest_expand, hip_ease), each with a stable snake_case id addressable through the channel API and MCP edit surface.
Applying a fix dial deforms only the garment rest state within the region's projection footprint; body channels and other garment regions are untouched (isolation test).
Dial values persist with the garment fit row and survive EventLedger replay; re-fitting regenerates dials while preserving previously set values where regions still exist.
A poke-through fixture (extreme glute volume under a tight skirt) resolves to zero interpenetration by dialing the generated glute-region expand channel.
scope.risk_if_missed: Every extreme-body fit problem becomes a garment re-authoring round-trip; the cheap last-mile correction lane that the whole Daz ecosystem buys as a product (Fit Control) is missing from a tool that targets extreme bodies by design.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit, Cloth, and contact integration

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Reconcile the BodyKit cloth bridge with shared topology/material/collider snapshots, the per-tier interaction matrix, portal-aware cavity metadata, final f64 authority, and promotion-safe receipts without expanding BodyKit anatomy authoring in this slice.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.
Use PostgreSQL RLS/FORCE RLS and ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; UI filtering is never the security boundary.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
